newsitem.title: FRANCE: UPS opens new Nice office.
newsitem.headline: UPS opens new Nice office.

text.p: United Parcel Service, said it has responded to growing demand by opened a new 1,260 square metre distribution centre in Nice,double the surface area of previous facilities there.
In September 1996, UPS launched a programme of intra-France feeder flights using two tonne capacity cargo-configurated, Beechcraft 1900s wet-leased from French airline, Air Litto
One of the flights operates between Nice and UPS' sub-hub at Lyon-Satolas airport.
The other flights operate between UPS' principal French hub at Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport and Nantes and Strasbourg while two flights operate between Lyon-Satolas and Bordeaux and Toulouse.
The five feeders flights synchronise with UPS's Boeing 727F nightly services CDG to Cologne and Lyon-Satolas to Cologne. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
